name: Apex Predator
golden: Don't pick up or hit the duck. It's harmless until you do.
tells: A little duck that waddles after you and watches your camera.
behavior: Follows players around. If grabbed or damaged it turns into a flying predator form for about 10 seconds and bites repeatedly.
damage: Bites 3× per second in predator form (about 10 per bite, so up to roughly 30/s).
do: Crouch out of its line of sight so it loses interest
If you want the orb, lure it onto the extraction point and let the platform crush it
dont: Grab it, hit it or throw things at it
Let a teammate 'just test' it near the cart

counter.kill: Stun it first, or crush it with the extraction platform or scrap piston, which doesn't trigger the transformation.

notes: Sources differ on bite damage (10 per bite vs 30/s).

name: Bella
golden: Get out of her way. Three bell rings and she goes berserk.
tells: A little girl on a tricycle ringing a bell.
behavior: Rides a route around the map. She rings her bell when you block her or hang around too long. On the third ring she goes aggressive and fast. The ring counter resets after about 20 seconds.
damage: 5 per ram or hit, repeated while berserk.
do: Step off her route as soon as she rings
Back off or leave the room to let the counter reset
dont: Block corridors with the cart on her route
Swing at her while she attacks, because your weapon gets deflected

counter.kill: Stun her, then hit her. Easier to just avoid.

name: Birthday Boy
golden: Don't pop his balloons. Whoever pops one gets chased.
tells: Balloons placed around the map.
behavior: Places balloons around the map. If a player or their weapon pops one he chases that player. If an object pops one he comes to investigate. He crawls under counters and through small gaps.
damage: Charge and swing for 10, crawling hit for 10. He keeps slapping repeatedly.
do: Watch where you throw loot and swing weapons near balloons
If you popped one, zigzag around corners
dont: Hide under counters, because he crawls under them
Fire explosives in balloon rooms

counter.kill: Killing him removes all balloons. If he despawns and a balloon pops later, he comes back already angry.

name: Elsa
golden: PET THE DOG. Ignore her for about 15 seconds or hurt her and she transforms.
tells: A small friendly dog. A 'PET THE DOG!' prompt appears the first time she sees you.
behavior: Wanders up to players and wants pets. Petted, she calms down and leaves. Ignored, or hurt by players OR other monsters, she transforms and attacks.
damage: Charges and swings for 5–30. About 25 extra if she knocks you into a wall.
do: Pet her whenever she comes to you
Fight her in open rooms, not hallways, if she turns
dont: Hit her, even by accident
Lead other monsters into her, because their attacks set her off too

counter.kill: 600 HP and can't be grabbed. Use stun-heavy weapons like the sledgehammer, or knock her into a pit.

name: Gnome
golden: They're after your loot. Grab one and smash it before they chip your valuables.
tells: Packs of 3–5 small gnomes with pickaxes.
behavior: Goes for valuables first and chips away at them with pickaxes. Will also swing at players at very close range.
damage: 10 per pickaxe swing (about 1 s wind-up).
do: Pick one up and slam it into the floor, or throw it into the others
Keep fragile valuables away from them
dont: Leave the cart unattended near a pack
Waste weapon ammo on them

counter.kill: Grab and smash. Very weak, but there are many of them.

name: Peeper
golden: Break line of sight. It yanks your aim up and hurts you the longer it stares.
tells: An eye on the ceiling that snaps open and drags your camera toward it.
behavior: Locks onto one player at a time, forcing their aim upward toward it. Damage starts after about 3 seconds of lock.
damage: Damage over time after a ~3 s lock (sources say 2/s or 10/s).
do: Walk back the way you came to break line of sight
Have a teammate guide or drag the locked player out
Call out Peeper rooms so carriers avoid them
dont: Carry loot through its room, because you can't see where you're going
Try to fight it

counter.kill: Not worth fighting. Avoid its room.

notes: Sources disagree on damage per second and whether it drops an orb.

name: Shadow Child
hp: Low (one melee hit in most guides; 150 per Bloxodes)
golden: Look away from it. Staring triggers a delayed attack that pulls you in.
tells: A small dark child figure that giggles when it teleports.
behavior: If you keep looking at it, it attacks after a short delay, yanking you toward it. It teleports away on its own after about 10 seconds.
damage: 30–50 and a strong pull or launch.
do: Look away and let it teleport
Hit it once if you can reach it, because it's fragile
dont: Stare at it near pits or ledges, because the yank can throw you

counter.kill: One melee hit kills it in most guides.

notes: Buffed in v0.3.0: more damage and a harder yank.

name: Spewer
golden: If it latches on, get away from loot and teammates and shake it off.
tells: Constant gurgling. A tadpole-like creature.
behavior: Latches onto a player's face and makes them vomit for up to a minute. The vomit damages nearby players, valuables and even other monsters, and it's loud.
damage: Bile about 10 per hit (≈10/s when cornered).
do: Grab and shake it, or tumble, to get it off
Move the vomiting player away from the cart
Aim the vomit at monsters (it can kill a Clown in 2–3 vomits)
dont: Stand next to a vomiting teammate
Vomit near a Huntsman, because the noise draws its fire

counter.kill: Grab it and shake it off, then smash it.

name: Tick
golden: Low on HP? Leave it alone. It drains health and gets bigger.
tells: A small bug that jumps on your grab beam when you grab something nearby.
behavior: Attaches and drains health, growing as it feeds. Detaches after draining about 100 HP.
damage: Drains about 10 HP per second.
do: Smash it into a wall or floor quickly
Kill a fed Tick, because it pops into a healing cloud
dont: Grab objects next to it at low HP
Let it feed on a critically hurt teammate

counter.kill: Smash it quickly. A fed Tick leaves a healing cloud when it dies.

notes: Sources disagree on exactly how much it drains before detaching.

name: Animal
golden: Get the cart and valuables out of its path. It thrashes everything.
tells: A fast four-legged creature running around erratically.
behavior: When provoked it rampages erratically, smashing into players and valuables.
damage: Low: about 2 per contact, but it wrecks loot.
do: Climb onto high furniture or let it run itself out
Two players grabbing it at once freezes it, then slam it 2–3 times
Lead it into Gnomes, because it tramples them
dont: Fight it next to the cart

counter.kill: Double-grab to freeze it, then slam.

name: Banger
golden: Fuse lit? Back off. About 10 seconds, then it blows up.
tells: Groups of about 3. A fuse sound, then a warning yell just before the blast.
behavior: When alerted, it lights its fuse and rushes you, exploding after about 10 seconds. The blast also hurts monsters and valuables.
damage: Explosion about 30. Point-blank can be instant death.
do: Grab it and throw it into a pit, well, lava, acid or water
Throw it at other monsters
dont: Let it blow up next to the cart
Hold it too long, because it breaks free after about 3 s

counter.kill: Throw it into a hazard or at a monster. It's a free grenade.

name: Bowtie
golden: Get behind solid cover before it screams. The gust pushes you and your loot.
tells: Turns to face you, then lets out a huge scream.
behavior: Screams a forward gust that shoves players and valuables. You can't sprint or jump in it. It's slow and can't move while screaming.
damage: About 5 per collision or charge, more if it pins you or pushes you off a ledge.
do: Break line of sight behind walls
Sneak up behind it while it's distracted
dont: Stand near ledges, pits or lava in its line of sight
Leave valuables in front of it

counter.kill: Attack from behind. Tranq gun or firearms work well.

name: Chef
golden: Sidestep the moment it raises its knives, then punish the miss.
tells: A croak, a grin, then knives go up.
behavior: Leaps at you with spinning knives. If it misses, it's off-balance for about 3 seconds. It can jump over landmines and carts.
damage: 10 per knife hit, several hits per leap.
do: Dodge sideways, then attack during the recovery
Lift and slam with 3 Strength or two players (about 4 slams)
dont: Run in a straight line
Count on mines to stop it

counter.kill: Punish its recovery window after a miss.

name: Gambit
golden: Low HP? Run. Its roulette can leave you at 1 HP or cost you 50.
tells: Walks straight toward a player with a wheel.
behavior: Grabs a player and spins a roulette wheel: green +25 HP, white full heal, red −50, black drops you to 1 HP, yellow gives a money bag. Then it leaves for a while.
damage: Red slot −50, black slot sets you to 1 HP.
do: Run or hide before it reaches you when you're hurt
At full HP the gamble is mostly fine
dont: Stun it while it holds a teammate, because that deals 60 to the grabbed player

counter.kill: The grabbed player can attack during the spin. Don't stun it mid-grab.

name: Head Grab
golden: When a teammate dies, it goes for their head. Get to the head first.
tells: Shows up around dead players' bodies.
behavior: Takes a dead player's head and gets faster and more dangerous while holding it. It targets the player whose death camera it can see.
damage: Punches for 5–10, more often while holding a head.
do: Recover dead teammates' heads quickly
Dead player: switch spectate targets
Rip the head off it to stun it briefly
dont: Leave a body near it

counter.kill: Two players lift it, or use grab range upgrades.

name: Heart Hugger
golden: Stay outside its pink mist. It pulls you in and crushes you.
tells: A stationary plant with a floating heart. It sprays pink mist when it sees you.
behavior: Pink gas drags you toward the heart, where you get crushed or slapped several times.
damage: Heavy: 30 per slap, up to about 150 total.
do: Keep your distance and route around it
Have a teammate pull the victim out
Swing a weapon while being pulled
dont: Go near it alone
Expect a stun to cancel the grab, because it doesn't mid-grab

counter.kill: 300 HP. Sledgehammer works well. It's stationary, so you can skip it.

notes: Damage numbers differ between sources (60 vs 30 per slap ×5).

name: Hidden
golden: Heavy breathing and black footprints mean stick together. It carries off lone players.
tells: Heavy breathing, black footprints, foggy breath. Otherwise invisible.
behavior: Grabs a player, makes them drop everything, and carries them far away, sometimes into a monster's nest or back to the truck.
damage: None from the grab itself. The danger is where it drops you.
do: Buddy up
Grab your teammate (or the Hidden) to break the carry
Spam tumble to stun-lock it
dont: Carry valuables alone when you hear breathing

counter.kill: Possible but unreliable. Traps on its route work.

name: Mentalist
golden: Stay out of its aura. It lifts you and slams you down for 50.
tells: No footsteps, just a floaty hum. It teleports.
behavior: Lifts nearby players and valuables in an anti-gravity field for about 10 seconds, then slams everything down.
damage: Slam about 50. A high lift can be fatal.
do: Hide, because it's deaf with poor eyesight
Pull a lifted teammate out of the field
Hit it from behind, because it's fragile
dont: Bring the cart into its aura
Stand over pits when it's nearby

counter.kill: A few melee hits from behind.

name: Oogly
golden: Get out of its spotlight. It dives on whoever is lit.
tells: A flying alien thing with a bright spotlight and plasma lines.
behavior: Patrols in the air with a detection light. Dives, grabs and tosses whoever is in the light.
damage: About 4/s while held (around 5 s), or around 40 per swoop.
do: Leave the lit area or the room
Hide under objects
Grab it during a dive
dont: Melee it while it's in the air
Carry loot through its light

counter.kill: Stun or frag grenades, then grab it.

name: Rugrat
golden: Put valuables down. It goes after whoever is carrying loot and throws it at you.
tells: A crawling baby heading for players with valuables.
behavior: Steals valuables (up to two) and throws them at players. Runs off when it has nothing to throw.
damage: Depends on the weight of the thrown item.
do: Drop loot and let an empty-handed teammate deal with it
Lift it with 2–3 players or 3 Strength, then slam it
dont: Fight it while holding expensive items

counter.kill: Team lift and slam into wall or floor.

name: Upscream
golden: Stay away from pits. It grabs, screams and throws you.
tells: Groups of 2–3. A shout right before the throw.
behavior: Grabs a player, screams in their face and throws them, stunning them for about 2 seconds.
damage: About 10 per throw, plus a 2 s stun.
do: Melee it (sledgehammer is great) or tranq it
Slam it into a wall once it's down
dont: Fight near ledges, pits or lava

counter.kill: Low HP. Tranq, then grab and slam.

name: Cleanup Crew
golden: When it throws its head, juke sideways. The blast and toxic gas wreck players and loot.
tells: A hulking figure that throws its own head.
behavior: Throws its head when it sees you. The head bounces, explodes and leaves toxic or radiation gas. It regrows the head, and drops one last head when it dies.
damage: Head blast up to about 90–100, gas about 15/s, melee about 20 (+40 into a wall).
do: Run with sharp turns, not in a straight line
Grab the thrown head and throw it sideways
Back off after killing it, because the last head still explodes
dont: Clump up
Leave valuables or orbs near the gas

counter.kill: 350 HP. Grab a leg to topple it, then go all-in.

notes: Gamer.org lists a 'Bombthor' separately. Other guides only know this monster as Cleanup Crew / Bombthrower.

name: Clown
golden: Hear laughing? Get behind real walls. The laser one-shots and goes through doors.
tells: Loud footsteps and laughter before the beam.
behavior: Roams until it spots someone, then sweeps a horizontal laser that adjusts to your height. It also kicks hard. After the laser it has a cooldown.
damage: Laser 100 (one-shot). Kick 50–60 with knockback.
do: Use solid walls as cover
Crouch once the sweep starts
Attack during the cooldown after a laser
Bait the laser from a jump-only ledge, because it can't jump
dont: Hide behind doors, cabinets or safes, because the laser destroys them
Stand in long open hallways

counter.kill: Hit it during the post-laser cooldown. Spewer vomit also hurts it.

name: Headman
golden: Turn your flashlight away from it and break line of sight through a doorway.
tells: A floating head with no footsteps, only clicking teeth.
behavior: Floats around. Bites as soon as it sees you, and flashlights make it hiss and charge. Long cooldown after each bite.
damage: Bite about 50 with knockback.
do: Go through a doorway or turn a corner and hide
Melee it after a bite, because it has terrible reach
Shoot it, because it has a big hitbox
dont: Shine your flashlight at it

counter.kill: Melee during its bite cooldown, or guns.

name: Huntsman
golden: Be silent. It's blind, but shoots at any sound, including voice chat.
tells: Patrols a fixed route with a shotgun. Grunts about 0.5 s before firing.
behavior: Fires at the last sound it heard: footsteps, dropped loot, explosions, voice and even text chat. It doesn't chase. Stepping off stairs or ledges stuns it briefly.
damage: Shotgun up to 100. Instant death up close, weaker at range. About 2 s reload.
do: Crouch-walk and mute voice near it
Throw an item to misdirect its shot
Attack from cover during the reload
dont: Melee it
Drop or slam loot near its route
Sprint past it

counter.kill: Knock it down stairs, tranq it, or use grenades, mines or guns. Never melee.

name: Loom
golden: Hands at the edges of your screen mean it's hunting YOU. Keep moving and never stop.
tells: Hands creeping in at the edges of your screen. A slow, crouched figure.
behavior: Locks onto one random player and always knows where they are. Claps or pinches for a one-shot. It despawns after five misses. It doesn't spawn on level 1.
damage: Clap or pinch 100, even if you're crouched.
do: Keep moving or crouch-run
Sprint away right after a miss
Make it miss five times to despawn it
dont: Hide and wait, because it knows where you are
Rely on fall damage, because it's immune to fall and impact damage

counter.kill: 500 HP and immune to impact. Only weapons or thrown items hurt it.

name: Pony
golden: Look up. It hangs from the ceiling, tongue-grabs you and steals what you carry.
tells: A whinny overhead. It often moves across the ceiling.
behavior: Drops from ceilings, tongue-grabs players, steals carried items and weapons, kicks, and throws you into terrain. Its death sends out a stunning shockwave.
damage: Tongue grab about 55. Kick about 10. Thrown into terrain about 60.
do: Check ceilings often
Keep your distance and strafe sideways
Carry a stun weapon, because it can only be grabbed when stunned
dont: Kill it next to a pit, because the death shockwave stuns everyone nearby
Carry your best valuable under it

counter.kill: Stun it, then grab and punish.

notes: New in v0.5.0 (Sunstone Update, Oct 2026). Official notes only say 'New Enemy - Pony!', so details come from early player guides.

name: Reaper
golden: Break line of sight. It forgets you fast, and its spinning blades shred you.
tells: Very quiet footsteps, so it appears suddenly. Spinning arms.
behavior: Slow, short chases with spinning blade arms. Mostly deaf, but reacts to the grab beam. Crouching helps you stay hidden.
damage: Blades can take you from 100 to 0 in about 2 s.
do: Approach from behind while it's idle
Crouch and slip out of view
Use tranq or ranged weapons
dont: Attack into the spinning arms
Use your grab beam near it

counter.kill: Slow and predictable. Ranged weapons or tranq, then melee from behind.

name: Robe
golden: DON'T LOOK AT IT. Eye contact sends it into a full-speed chase.
tells: A tall robed figure, often sneaking up from behind.
behavior: Hears noise and speeds up when your crosshair meets it. Hunts hidden players and checks under furniture.
damage: Charge about 50–100 with extreme knockback.
do: Look at the floor and walk away
Hide in deep cover and stay silent until it leaves
Flee if you don't have a stun tool AND a heavy weapon
dont: Look at it
Fight it, because explosives barely faze it
Make noise near it

counter.kill: Not practical. Avoid.

name: Trudge
golden: Leave the area. Don't hide nearby, because it pulls you out of hiding spots.
tells: A dragging mace you can hear through walls, and heavy footsteps.
behavior: Slow, but pulls nearby players and valuables in, then smashes. Reaches into hiding spots with a tendril.
damage: Mace slam about 100 (often instant death). Bite on hidden players about 50.
do: Leave the room or wing entirely
Use mines if you want the kill, and bring enough of them
dont: Hide in a nearby closet
Fight in tight hallways or small rooms

counter.kill: 500 HP. Only with a plan: stack mines or explosives.
